justification: MX06 Phase 1 ships the crate skeleton; constructors probe for libcuda / nvcuda via the runtime-loaded cuda-compute wrapper. No filesystem, network, process, or environment access. On hosts without an NVIDIA driver, CudaExecutor::new() returns Err and the planner skips this executor. Phase 5+ will use the driver API for GPU buffer allocation and kernel dispatch — still in-process, no privileged ops.
